eqLameRecup.title: The Recovered Blade
eqLameRecup.description: A blacksmith from The Wreckyard talks about an old blade buried in the scrap. He needs materials to restore it.

eqGiletGarde.title: The Fallen Guard's Vest
eqGiletGarde.description: A former Fort Kharos guard is selling his gear. He wants to leave the sector. He needs fuel and credits.
eqGiletGarde.armorDesc: The former owner left. The vest stayed behind.

eqFusilFantome.title: The Ghost's Rifle
eqFusilFantome.description: A rumor circulates at Ghost Station: a legendary weapon is hidden in the ventilation ducts. To find it, you must have survived there.
eqFusilFantome.weaponEffect: Blinds the enemy for 1 turn. Found in the ducts of a station that doesn't exist.

eqArmureMira.title: The Armor of the Depths
eqArmureMira.description: The miners of Mira talk about a crystalline armor found in the deepest galleries. It has strange properties.
eqArmureMira.armorDesc: The crystals of Mira reflect energy.

eqLameNoctis.title: The Noctis Commission
eqLameNoctis.description: A craftsman at The Black Forge can forge a Noctis-quality blade — but he needs specific components and proof of worth.
eqLameNoctis.weaponEffect: Strikes twice (×0.85 each). Forged deep within The Black Forge.

eqCanonVelkor.title: The Cannon of the Abyss
eqCanonVelkor.description: In the Velkor Abyss, a pre-Fracture weapon prototype awaits restoration. Classified data is needed to unlock its vault.

eqArmureEcarlate.title: The Scarlet Armor
eqArmureEcarlate.description: The Scarlet Guardians keep a legendary armor in their Arsenal. Earning it demands loyalty and blood.
eqArmureEcarlate.armorDesc: Worn by the Guardians' champions. +10 HP/turn.

eqVampirelleMk2.title: Vampirella Mk.II
eqVampirelleMk2.description: Doctor Flinch at The Bubble has perfected vampiric technology. He needs biological components and test subjects... or just credits.
eqVampirelleMk2.weaponEffect: Steals 35% of damage as HP. Improved version by Flinch.

eqLameNexus.title: The Blade of the Nexus
eqLameNexus.description: The ruins of The Cradle hide the oldest weapon in the sector. Forged before the Fracture, it needs artifacts from every corner of the sector to be reactivated.
eqLameNexus.weaponEffect: Strike + instant max momentum. The weapon that existed before everything.

eqArmureSingularite.title: The Singularity Project
eqArmureSingularite.description: ARIA-9 at Sanctum Machina holds the plans for an armor that isn't supposed to exist. Building it requires the cooperation of a human mind and an AI.
eqArmureSingularite.armorDesc: Absorbs one fatal hit. A forbidden project. Perfect.

eqSceptreRoi.title: The Lost King's Scepter
eqSceptreRoi.description: The Lost Arc holds the weapon of a forgotten king. Raphazarus knows where it is — but he'll only give it to someone who has proven their worth on the battlefield.
eqSceptreRoi.weaponEffect: Damage × (1 + 1.5×%missing HP), max ×2.5. The weapon of a king who lost everything — except his fury.
